threat_event: Malicious script injected into a payment page skims card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Script inventory and change detection on 1 of 3 storefront brands
existing_controls: Hosted payment fields; content security policy on one brand
treatment_plan: Script inventory, authorization, and tamper detection on all brands

threat_event: Call recordings that contain card numbers and security codes are exposed
threat_source: Attacker at the contact center vendor or insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pause-and-resume not enforced; about 12% of sampled phone orders recorded card data
treatment_plan: Automatic pause during card entry; purge affected recordings; move phone payments to keypad entry
owner: Online Retail vice president of customer care

threat_event: Consumer accounts are taken over by credential stuffing
existing_controls: Bot detection; step-up on new devices
treatment_plan: Passkeys and step-up for stored payment tokens

threat_event: Third-party sellers list counterfeit electronics on the marketplace
existing_controls: Takedown process; reporting mechanism on listings
treatment_plan: Clear the backlog; brand registry for top OEMs; Section 889 check on electronics listings

threat_event: Support staff misuse seller bank or tax data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 210 support staff can see seller financial data

threat_event: Tampered consumer routers from group stock are sold to consumers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Online Retail relies on Logistics receiving checks
treatment_plan: Serial validation at all DCs (LW-005); consumer advisory process in P08

threat_event: The FTC or a state attorney general finds INFORM Consumers Act violations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 46 high-volume sellers past the 10-day verification window
treatment_plan: Clear the backlog; suspend sellers after notice as the Act requires

threat_event: Required CCPA risk assessments are not completed for sharing personal information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No risk assessment started for cross-context behavioral advertising

threat_event: The payment service provider has an extended outage and the untested secondary route fails
A denial-of-service attack takes the storefront down during peak season
The fraud screening model declines legitimate orders, with higher decline rates for some customer groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No subgroup monitoring of decline rates
treatment_plan: Decline-rate monitoring by proxy segments (P10 AI-002)
owner: Online Retail director of fraud prevention

threat_event: The customer service AI assistant discloses order details to the wrong person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assistant can read order history after weak identity checks
existing_controls: Order lookup requires email and order number
treatment_plan: One-time code before order details (P10 AI-004)
owner: Online Retail vice president of customer care

threat_event: Returned devices are resold with a prior customer data still on them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Wipe verification sampled at one of two returns centers
treatment_plan: Use the Lifecycle Services sanitization method and sampling

threat_event: Bots buy up limited-release products for resale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bot controls tuned for fraud, not hoarding
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Online Retail security and compliance lead (2026-08-20): business impact is reputational only; purchase limits in place

threat_event: A web application flaw exposes the consumer account database
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5.8 million accounts; one storefront brand outside the standard pipeline
treatment_plan: Move the third brand into the standard pipeline; quarterly testing
